description: Attach a continuity or review note to a scene as compatibility review metadata. Flags are not canonical relationship authority and do not mutate SQLite; use audit_relationship_metadata, connect_character_place_evidence, record_character_relationship_beat, or link_reference_evidence when the note identifies relationship repair work.

note.description: The flag note (e.g. 'Victor knows Mira’s name here, but they haven’t been introduced yet — contradicts sc-006').
